question: Investigate how Apple's revenue mix changed over the last three years. Identify the major changes and summarize the factors management cited for those changes.
required_points: Services net sales grew from $85,200M (FY2023) to $109,158M (FY2025), rising from about 22% to about 26% of total net sales
iPhone net sales were roughly flat in FY2024 and rose 4% in FY2025 ($200,583M to $209,586M), due to higher net sales of Pro models in FY2025
Wearables, Home and Accessories declined in both years ($39,845M to $35,686M), due to lower net sales of Wearables and Accessories
Mac grew in both years ($29,357M to $33,708M), due to higher net sales of laptops (and desktops in FY2025)
Services growth was attributed to higher net sales from advertising, the App Store and cloud services

sources.evidence: Services net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to higher net sales from advertising, the App Store and cloud services.
iPhone net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 due to higher net sales of Pro models.
iPhone net sales were relatively flat during 2024 compared to 2023.
Wearables, Home and Accessories net sales decreased during 2024 compared to 2023 due primarily to lower net sales of Wearables and Accessories.

notes: PRD demo task 5 (flagship). 'Last three years' = FY2023–FY2025. Shares computed by script: Services 85,200/383,285 = 22.2%; 109,158/416,161 = 26.2%. FY2023 category values should also be confirmed in the FY2023 10-K.
